    Goals

    Progress · bullets · next steps

    1 · Daily Agency

    10-min morning timer. Three concrete “I choose” statements tied to one dream (land, cabin, SpaceX-level work, or autonomy). Decisions only — no journaling.

    2 · Savings Lock

    $4k/month automatic transfers same day as payday. 50% cash emergency ($10k → $60k), 30% TSLA/SpaceX on dips, 20% opportunistic. Zero daily decisions.

    3 · Quiet Production

    90-day rule at KM: one clean, on-time set of construction documents every 2–3 weeks using only Civil 3D + AI that already works. No process talk. Buy capital and time.

    4 · Career Criteria

    Pre-decide with kill criteria: (a) stay & extract max leverage 12–18 months, (b) apply only to Boring/SpaceX/Tesla senior civil/PM with one email template, (c) scale Salient only if side revenue hits $3k+/month. Review quarterly.

    5 · Hand + Body

    Book Seattle consult now. Until then: 3×/week 20-min squat/yoga only. Health is the lowest-effort force multiplier.

    6 · One Agent

    This month: one reusable AI agent for Ajera/timesheets/invoicing. ≤4 focused hours. Automate the highest-friction weekly task.

    7 · Land Filter

    30-min Sundays only. Criteria locked: Sandpoint-area, 3–7 acres, trees + water access, ≤$X, flag-lot potential. Delete the rest of the mental load.

    8 · Templates

    One afternoon: best drainage letter, plat checklist, fee schedule → copy-paste assets. Future Texas/Upwork gigs become 30–60 min fills.

    9 · No Consumption

    Hard rule until net worth hits $40k. No new tools, courses, camper upgrades, or aesthetic cabin purchases. Redirect every impulse into savings.

    10 · Sunday Score

    5-minute binary scorecard. Three columns only: Protect savings rate? Ship work product? Move one step on land/health? Yes/no. Adjust next week from the scores.

    Execute in this order. The first three create the psychological and financial runway; the rest ride on that.

            Body, mind, nature, and the habits that compound. Living repository — nothing has to die here.

            Synergy Map

            Foundation

            Sleep · protein · walking · no-alcohol baseline

            → Energy for work + clear head for building

            Movement & Nature

            Yoga · lower-body strength · local parks · ski / camp weekends

            → Mood (DOSE) + recovery from desk / hand limits

            Targeted support

            Supplements · mushrooms · hand recovery path

            → Fill gaps; don’t replace food, sleep, or movement

            Baseline that compounds

            Protein · sleep · consistency

            Vision

            A simple, repeatable floor: high-protein / low-carb intuitive eating, consistent sleep window, daily walk or yoga, and staying off alcohol/tobacco because your body now rejects them. Not optimization theater — just the platform everything else sits on.

            Science / why

            Protein + resistance preserves muscle in a deficit. Morning light and walks support circadian rhythm and serotonin. Alcohol disrupts sleep architecture and recovery; your recent acute negative reactions are useful signal, not failure.

            Recommended next steps

            • • Protect one non-negotiable: e.g. 10–15 min walk or yoga most days
            • • Keep protein high and carbs intuitive — no need for perfect tracking
            • • Treat alcohol/tobacco as closed experiments for now

            Your notes

              Movement (hand-aware)

              Legs · yoga · walks

              Vision

              Train around the left-hand constraint: prioritize legs, posterior chain, walking, swimming, and yoga. Upper-body work stays light or post-PT. Goal isn’t a PE peak — it’s durable energy, mood, and a body that can still build a cabin someday.

              Synergies

              Lower-body strength + walks feed the nature-escape habit. Yoga doubles as stress/mental reset. Consistent movement makes the supplement stack optional, not primary.

              Paths

              • • Minimum: 2–3× lower-body or yoga + daily short walk
              • • Weekend: one longer hike or ski day when schedule allows
              • • Hand path: keep Seattle PT plan on the radar; don’t force bench/press patterns

              Your notes

                Supplements & bio support

                Mag · D3 · Omega-3 · Creatine · Protein

                Current stack (from our talks)

                Core candidates: Mag glycinate, D3/K2 or D3, Omega-3, protein as needed. Optional / situational: MCT or mushroom coffee, curcumin, glucosamine+MSM, probiotics, L-glutamine, B12, green tea extract, sleep aids (magnesium, low-dose melatonin, or 5-HTP only if needed). DIY mushroom blends (Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Cordyceps, etc.) as a cheaper Mud Wtr-style option.

                Science-backed stance

                Prioritize deficiencies and recovery (D, mag, omega-3, protein). Treat the rest as experiments with a clear “stop if no benefit in 4–6 weeks” rule. Hand/joint support (curcumin, glucosamine) is reasonable while waiting on PT/surgery planning.

                Recommended next steps

                • • Keep the core small; don’t run 12 things at once
                • • If trying mushrooms, start with one blend and note energy/focus for 2 weeks
                • • Revisit stack after bloodwork or post-hand-plan if you get labs

                Your notes
